Data Sources
upload a file or connect S3" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="60" width="220" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p_eda" value="2. EDA
profile a dataset: correlations,
outliers, target analysis" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="270" y="60" width="220" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p_canvas" value="3. ML Canvas (Canvas view)
build a pipeline from nodes,
Preview data, train or tune" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="520" y="60" width="220" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p_jobs" value="4. Jobs page, Experiments view
follow jobs as they run,
compare metrics of runs" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="770" y="60" width="220" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p_registry" value="5. Model Registry
completed train/tune jobs
as versions; Deploy, Export" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#F3E8FF;strokeColor=#9673A6;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="770" y="200" width="220" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p_deploy" value="6. Deployments
the one active model, deployed
from Experiments or Registry" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="520" y="200" width="220" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p_infer" value="7. Inference (ML Canvas view)
send rows to the active model,
read the predictions" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="270" y="200" width="220" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p_drift" value="8. Data Drift
upload new data, compare it
with a trained job's reference" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="200" width="220" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g_any" value="Any time" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=4;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=6;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="320" width="970" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p_dash" value="Dashboard
totals, recent jobs,

server errors (5xx) and
pipeline failures" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="275" y="355" width="215" height="66" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p_slow" value="Slow Nodes
